items.title: From QuickSight to Quick (What happens to your dashboards and users) | AWS Quick: Zero to Hero 15
items.summary: Level 200. A handout on what the move from Amazon QuickSight to AWS Quick means for your dashboards and users, for admins and analysts at companies that use Amazon QuickSight. It covers what changed (Amazon QuickSight is now AWS Quick Sight, a feature of AWS Quick, and existing content, APIs, SDKs, and integrations keep working; the new tools next to your dashboards); where users go (per-user Readers move up to Essentials at no extra per-user cost, Region by Region; Authors get Enterprise until an end date; BI-only pricing; where costs can change); and making the move (the Tokyo Region as an example, choosing dashboards and datasets as data for chat, what to decide before Readers move up, where to set it, and opening the new tools to one team first). The screenshots show the web app with the English display language. The rollout order is the author's suggestion, not an official AWS procedure. The appendix has roles and plans, a glossary, and sources. Based on public documentation as of November 2026. Deck 15 (Roll it out) of the series AWS Quick: Zero to Hero.
